clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or appropriately authorised specialist named in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00596 Version 2. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

indications.description: Relapsed Ewing sarcoma or osteosarcoma (NCCP00596b does not specify relapse).

treatment.schedule_summary: Etoposide100mg/m² then ifosfamide1800mg/m² on Days1–5 every21days, up to7cycles.

mucositis_grade.label: Mucositis/stomatitis grade
mucositis_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess pain, ulceration and the effect on oral intake; distinguish altered diet from inability to eat or drink.

other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.label: Worst relevant non-haematological toxicity
other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Identify the exact adverse event and grade it using its own CTCAE criteria, objective findings, intervention required and functional impact.

encephalopathy_grade.label: Ifosfamide-associated encephalopathy/neurotoxicity grade
encephalopathy_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess confusion, somnolence, agitation, hallucinations, seizures, consciousness and effect on self-care; exclude metabolic, infectious and drug causes.

eligibility: Exact listed indication; adequate hepatic, renal and marrow function.
exclusions: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component
Pregnancy or breastfeeding where prohibited by the current source
Regimen-specific exclusions encoded in the interactive assessment
monitoring: FBC, renal and liver profiles at baseline and before each cycle.
Neurological assessment before every ifosfamide dose; check haematuria before each dose and every8hours on treatment days.
Strict fluid balance, urine output and daily weight; hydration extends24hours after ifosfamide ends.
Sodium, potassium and phosphate at baseline and regularly.
Observe etoposide infusion, particularly first15minutes, for hypotension.
dose_modifications: Current count delay always overrides future percentage discussion.
Ifosfamide CrCl<50 or haemodialysis: individual clinical decision; severe hepatic impairment not recommended.
Exact source-specific neurotoxicity management; retain prior severe/stop history.
All concurrent percentage/history/organ adjustments require one reconciled prescription; no multiplication or automatic re-escalation.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Risk assigned from the most emetogenic active component and treatment phase.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for high emetogenic risk
additional_supportive_care: Source-specific mesna and individual IV hydration/electrolyte prescriptions are essential; mesna does not prevent kidney or brain toxicity.
premedications: No usual separate regimen premedication; individual high-risk antiemetic plan with aprepitant interaction review.

treatment_phases.label: main cycle
treatment_phases.duration: Ifosfamide infusion over60minutes after etoposide; hydration continues24hours after completion.

administration.note: 1000mL NaCl0.9% over60minutes before ifosfamide; observe particularly first15minutes for hypotension.
Ifosfamide infusion over60minutes after etoposide; hydration continues24hours after completion.
Three separately prescribed doses daily: before,4hours and8hours after ifosfamide START; each over15minutes.
